app.name: Custom Diagram Creator

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Query Smartscape entities (smartscapeNodes) and list entities in the picker

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Query events, Davis events and Davis problems (dt.davis.problems)

scopes.name: storage:user.events:read
scopes.comment: Query RUM user events in KPIs

scopes.name: storage:user.sessions:read
scopes.comment: Query RUM user sessions in KPIs

scopes.name: storage:user.replays:read
scopes.comment: Query session replay records in KPIs

scopes.name: storage:system:read
scopes.comment: Query dt.system.* data objects (e.g. the lookup file list in storage administration)

scopes.name: storage:fieldsets:read
scopes.comment: Read fields protected by fieldset permissions

scopes.name: storage:files:read
scopes.comment: Read any lookup table (load / lookup in KPIs) and the diagrams lookup
